name: Nabisco Houston Sales Distribution Center - Houston TX

fieldNotes.locate: COULD NOT RESOLVE. Roster supplied only an APPROXIMATE city-level coordinate (29.7604, -95.3698), which is downtown Houston TX (skyscraper core). No specific building was findable. Web research (Mondelez office-locations page, Indeed/ZipRecruiter job portals, Dun & Bradstreet, news archives) returned no published street address for an active Nabisco/Mondelez sales distribution center in Houston. The historic Houston Nabisco bakery (2450 Holcombe Blvd / 'National Biscuit Company Building') was shuttered in 1999 and converted to lofts - it is NOT this facility. The only current Mondelez/Nabisco TX site with a published address is 1001 Assembly Cir, Schertz TX (San Antonio metro), a separate site. Satellite probe at the supplied coordinate (zoom 16) confirms the downtown Houston skyscraper core, not an industrial DC.
